sloka: तं शीघ्रमभिगच्छ त्वं यदि युद्धमिहेच्छसि ।स हि दुर्धर्षणो नित्यं शूरस्समरकर्मणि ॥४-११-२३॥।।
transliteration: taṁ śīghramabhigaccha tvaṁ yadi yuddhamihecchasi ।sa hi durdharṣaṇo nityaṁ śūrassamarakarmaṇi ॥4-11-23॥।।

translations.english: 'If you wish to fight, go to him quickly.He is ever heroic and difficult to combat.
